test_BaseConfig_nested_creation: test that nested BaseConfig subclasses like OuterConfig and InnerConfig can be instantiated with required fields
test_BaseConfig_as_dict: test the as_dict method on a BaseConfig instance to verify it returns a flat dictionary of all fields
test_BaseConfig_freeze: test the freeze method on a BaseConfig to ensure the config and all subconfigs become immutable
test_BaseConfig_unfreeze: test the unfreeze context manager on a BaseConfig to temporarily allow mutations then re-freeze
test_BaseConfig_autocreate: test the autocreate helper to auto-instantiate nested BaseConfig fields with default values when not explicitly provided
